name: Red Horizon real-model path image set
purpose: Use supplied level/character/enemy models to define the next playable route.

shots.title: Real model route: tower to chasm to industrial court
shots.beat: The supplied level’s strongest path starts at the left cannon, crosses the chasm, fights in the right court, and extracts at the right outpost.
shots.playerAction: Understand the full route before flying.
shots.developerTarget: Replace the old Bridgehead target with this real-model route contract.

shots.title: Launch from the real planetary cannon platform
shots.beat: Start on the left tower silhouette so the first second already feels like Red Horizon.
shots.playerAction: Hold forward and fly off the cannon platform toward the fork.
shots.developerTarget: Set spawn, objective, and camera around the real cannon platform anchor.

shots.title: Fork over the chasm
shots.beat: The route decision should happen while the player sees the abyss and both lines.
shots.playerAction: Choose high charge across the upper bridge or low shield down to the pipe run.
shots.developerTarget: Make reward locking and fork UI happen here, before the player commits.

shots.title: High route uses the real upper bridge/deck line
shots.beat: The high line stays readable because it rides the upper crossing and city-edge surfaces already in the level.
shots.playerAction: Descend onto the upper bridge/deck, boost through the high gate, then dodge in open space.
shots.developerTarget: Use these anchors for high-route markers, charge reward, camera capture, and collision proxy.

shots.title: Low route follows the real pipe / utility crossing
shots.beat: The low path is not another flat bridge; it is a lower utility lane that sells risk and protection.
shots.playerAction: Drop, center over the pipe run, earn shield, then climb to side cover.
shots.developerTarget: Build a visible hover lane and matching simplified collision because the raw pipe is narrow.

shots.title: Warden staged in the real industrial court
shots.beat: Both routes end in the right industrial cluster, which should become the main combat arena.
shots.playerAction: High dodges in the open; low peeks from the side-cover approach.
shots.developerTarget: Line up Warden phase visuals, projectile occlusion, cover, and reward damage here.

shots.title: Extraction at the far-right outpost pad
shots.beat: The finish is a separate right-side target instead of another marker floating in the court.
shots.playerAction: Leave the court, clear the buildings, and hold the extraction pad.
shots.developerTarget: Implement exit activation, hold timer, result stats, and replay copy around this outpost.

shots.title: Development contract from the real model
shots.beat: Every runtime task should use the same coordinates and mesh anchors as the images.
shots.playerAction: Use the overview to check whether gameplay still matches the real level.
shots.developerTarget: Gameplay, camera, collision, UI, Blender, and QA should all reference this path file.

player.beat: boost along the industrial deck edge

limitations: This is a design path from real model anchors, not yet a runtime collision or acceptance pass.
The lower pipe route is visually real but narrow; gameplay should use a visible hover lane and matching simplified collision proxy rather than raw mesh collision.
The full level remains visual context; the first playable route still needs simplified resident collision and authored mission markers.
Offline Blender images are design evidence; browser playtest evidence is still required.
The old Bridgehead v2 path was not used as the design target for this pass.
